title: Chapter 3 — AI Quiz: Hardware
instructions: Original AI-authored practice, not an official Cambridge or teacher paper. Answer all questions; written responses are self-marked using the guidance after submission. You can retake the quiz.
description: Original chapter practice: multiple-choice and written questions with self-marking guidance.

questions.text: Which component has no moving mechanical parts?
Explain why a buffer is used when devices transfer data at different rates.

answer.text: Allows the receiving device to process it at its own rate.

questions.text: Describe two differences between RAM and ROM.

answer.text: RAM is volatile; ROM is non-volatile.
RAM is normally read/write; ROM is normally read-only in normal operation.

questions.text: State one advantage and one disadvantage of an SSD compared with a hard disk drive.

answer.text: Advantage: faster access or more resistant to shock due to no moving parts.
Disadvantage: generally higher cost per unit of storage.

questions.text: Explain the role of an analogue-to-digital converter.

answer.text: Converts samples into digital values which can be processed by a computer.
